recentItems.title: ROBOTS ENTERED THE ENEMY'S REAR: Operation "Vivaldi" crushed the Russians!
recentItems.description:
Fires at Russian oil facilities, combat robots behind enemy lines, and suspected sabotage in Europe — in this new episode. We cover the attack on an oil depot in Krasnodar Krai, strikes on six Russian refineries in a single week, and the "Gryphon" tactics in Operation "Vivaldi." Also in this episode — Russia's budget struggles, food delivery by drones to Oleshky, and the aftermath of attacks on Kyiv. We analyze reports on threats to Magyar, a detention near an airbase in the UK, and arson attacks in Germany and Poland. How is Europe responding to hybrid threats, and why is Ukraine calling to stop the Kremlin's nuclear blackmail? Key events and their implications for security.

recentItems.title: HUNTING FOR PUTIN’S FUEL! Strikes on refineries hit Russian military logistics
recentItems.description:
In this new episode — strikes on the "Iskra" plant in Ulyanovsk and the refinery in Perm, secret Russian plans to attack Ukrainian energy infrastructure, and Western components in Russian weaponry. We analyze how damage to industrial facilities impacts Kremlin military logistics and how Ukraine is protecting sub-stations ahead of winter. We examine the diplomacy of Trump and Xi Jinping: can negotiations bring an end to the war closer? We also discuss warnings from Valerii Zaluzhnyi, sanctions evasion, and the supply of microchips for Russian drones and missiles. Watch the video to find out why cutting off these channels is crucial for the security of Ukraine and Europe.

recentItems.title: Did Putin order preparations for the FINAL WAR? Russia expands nuclear complex deep in the mountains
recentItems.description:
Russia is restoring garrisons near Finland and expanding the underground command post for its "Perimeter" nuclear system in the Urals. In this episode, we break down what this means for European security and report on arson attempts against defense enterprises, along with civilian preparedness efforts in the Netherlands. We also analyze how China, India, and Brazil could influence the Kremlin, whether tariffs on buyers of Russian oil can curb war funding, and the prospects for negotiations at the G20. Why Zelenskyy is calling for a crackdown on Russian revenues and what is holding partners back from tightening economic pressure on Moscow — watch in this episode.
